review.notes: Full review of the folder; in this folder the PR only moves the 0AFS supplier from PurityOfBranchLocus 0.3 to SchemeAndStackFoundations 4.13. Gate rerun at c07dda7: FAIL on readme-ids-missing=4 and outside-folder (2 real: Completed/ArithmeticDirichletSeries, SymplecticGeometry); depcheck 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with 7 sorry-only warnings; #check of all 12 declarations shows no lost binders. Seeded sample: 31 locators verified in the cached Stacks chapters 10, 15, 32, 49, 52, 58, SGA 2 X 3.4 and SGA 1 X 3.1/3.3; Stacks 0BM9 and 0BMA(2) need the torsion-free correction the roadmap makes; misprint in 0EY3. Blocking: Tau Ceti at the pin already has puncturedSpectrum, restrictPunctured, PurityHolds, 0BLK, 0BM8 affine, 0BM9 full faithfulness, 00R4, 0BJF over any base, 0BMA(2) for d=2, 0AFS, depth=dim and normality of regular local rings; Suggested.lean states the headlines through private stand-ins (R01), the README says no library has this and plans these as its own targets (R02), and the PR's new SSF 4.13 supplier restates pinned results (R03). Repaired headline signatures on TauCeti.IsLocalRing.PurityHolds and TauCeti.FiniteEtaleScheme.pullback elaborate in scratch; four Suggested theorems close by one exact of a pinned lemma (R04). Overlaps: #1807 and #1808 carry an identical LocalPurity README.
